title: Performance Report
description: Global/core iDoXs report showing planned, actual, missed, acceptable missed, and performance percentage, modeled after legacy rptPerformanceReport.php.

source.sql: select top 5000 pi.DISTRICT_ID as district_id, ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) as territory_id, nullif(ltrim(rtrim(concat('(', pi.TERRITORY_ID, ') ', isnull(p.LAST_NAME, ''), ', ', isnull(p.FIRST_NAME, '')))), '(),') as territory_name, count_big(*) as planned, sum(case when i.VISIT_DATE is not null then 1 else 0 end) as actual, sum(case when i.VISIT_DATE is null then 1 else 0 end) as missed, sum(case when i.REASON_CODE <> 'V' and i.REASON_CODE <> '0' then 1 else 0 end) as acceptable, cast(case when (count_big(*) - sum(case when i.REASON_CODE <> 'V' and i.REASON_CODE <> '0' then 1 else 0 end)) = 0 then null else (sum(case when i.VISIT_DATE is not null then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / (count_big(*) - sum(case when i.REASON_CODE <> 'V' and i.REASON_CODE <> '0' then 1 else 0 end))) end as decimal(18,2)) as performance from [dbo].[ITINERARY] i join [dbo].[PSR_ITINERARY] pi on i.ITINERARY_DATE = pi.ITINERARY_DATE and i.PSR_ID = pi.PSR_ID join [dbo].[PSR] p on i.PSR_ID = p.PSR_ID left join [dbo].[DOCTOR_CLINIC] dc on i.MD_ID = dc.MD_ID and i.TERRITORY_ID = dc.TERRITORY_ID where i.[YEAR] = @fiscalYear and ((@reportType = 'Cycle' and i.[MONTH] = @periodCode) or (@reportType <> 'Cycle' and i.[MONTH] <= @periodCode)) and p.TERRITORY_ID not in ('RRICT') {{territoryPredicate:i.TERRITORY_ID}} group by pi.DISTRICT_ID, pi.TERRITORY_ID, nullif(ltrim(rtrim(concat('(', pi.TERRITORY_ID, ') ', isnull(p.LAST_NAME, ''), ', ', isnull(p.FIRST_NAME, '')))), '(),') order by district_id, territory_id

businessFormulas.label: Planned
businessFormulas.description: Total itinerary rows in the selected cycle/YTD and territory scope.

businessFormulas.label: Actual
businessFormulas.description: Planned calls with a non-null visit date.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when VISIT_DATE is not null then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: Missed
businessFormulas.description: Planned calls without a visit date.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when VISIT_DATE is null then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: Acceptable Missed
businessFormulas.description: Legacy acceptable missed calls based on reason code not V and not 0.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when REASON_CODE <> 'V' and REASON_CODE <> '0' then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: Performance %
businessFormulas.description: Actual calls divided by effective planned calls after acceptable misses.
businessFormulas.zeroDenominatorBehavior: return null when Planned - Acceptable is zero

dataSourceDefinition.notes: Preserves legacy Performance Report formula: Performance = Actual / (Planned - Acceptable) * 100.
